mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStatusList */ C.COMD_CODE AS USER_STAT , C.COMD_NAME AS USER_STAT_NAME , COUNT(U.USER_NUMB) AS USER_CNTT FROM TB_CODEXD C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_STAT = C.COMD_CODE WHERE C.COMM_CODE = #{userStatCode} AND C.USEE_YSNO = #{yes} GROUP BY C.COMD_CODE , C.COMD_NAME , C.SORT_ORDR ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR , C.COMD_CODE

WITH RECURSIVE DATE_RANGE AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AS STAT_DATE UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(D.STAT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS STAT_DATE FROM DATE_RANGE D WHERE D.STAT_DATE < #{endDate} ) , JOIN_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(U.JOIN_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS JOIN_CNTT FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.JOIN_DATE >= #{startDate} AND U.JOIN_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(U.JOIN_DATE) ) , REPORT_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(R.REGI_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS REPORT_CNTT FROM TM_REPORT R WHERE R.REGI_DATE >= #{startDate} AND R.REGI_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(R.REGI_DATE) ) , REPLY_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(P.REGI_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS REPLY_CNTT FROM TB_REPLXX P WHERE P.REGI_DATE >= #{startDate} AND P.REGI_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(P.REGI_DATE) ) , LIKE_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(K.REGI_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS LIKE_CNTT FROM TB_LIKEXX K WHERE K.REGI_DATE >= #{startDate} AND K.REGI_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(K.REGI_DATE) ) , FOLLOW_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(F.REGI_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS FOLLOW_CNTT FROM TB_FOLLOW F WHERE F.REGI_DATE >= #{startDate} AND F.REGI_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(F.REGI_DATE) ) , ACTIVE_LOGIN AS ( SELECT DATE(H.LOGN_DATE) AS LOGN_DATE , H.USER_NUMB AS USER_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM U INNER JOIN TB_LOGHIS H ON H.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_STAT = #{active} AND H.LOGN_DATE >= DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND H.LOGN_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(H.LOGN_DATE) , H.USER_NUMB ) , ACTIVE_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT D.STAT_DATE AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.LOGN_DATE = D.STAT_DATE THEN L.USER_NUMB END) AS DAU_CNTT , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L.LOGN_DATE >= DATE_SUB(D.STAT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 DAY) THEN L.USER_NUMB END) AS WAU_CNTT , COUNT(DISTINCT L.USER_NUMB) AS MAU_CNTT FROM DATE_RANGE D LEFT JOIN ACTIVE_LOGIN L ON L.LOGN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(D.STAT_DATE, INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND D.STAT_DATE GROUP BY D.STAT_DATE ) SELECT /* getUserTrendList */ D.STAT_DATE AS STAT_DATE , COALESCE(J.JOIN_CNTT, 0) AS JOIN_CNTT , COALESCE(R.REPORT_CNTT, 0) AS REPORT_CNTT , COALESCE(P.REPLY_CNTT, 0) AS REPLY_CNTT , COALESCE(K.LIKE_CNTT, 0) AS LIKE_CNTT , COALESCE(F.FOLLOW_CNTT, 0) AS FOLLOW_CNTT , COALESCE(A.DAU_CNTT, 0) AS DAU_CNTT , COALESCE(A.WAU_CNTT, 0) AS WAU_CNTT , COALESCE(A.MAU_CNTT, 0) AS MAU_CNTT FROM DATE_RANGE D LEFT JOIN JOIN_ACTIVITY J ON J.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN REPORT_ACTIVITY R ON R.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN REPLY_ACTIVITY P ON P.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN LIKE_ACTIVITY K ON K.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN FOLLOW_ACTIVITY F ON F.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN ACTIVE_ACTIVITY A ON A.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE ORDER BY D.STAT_DATE

SELECT /* getUserInactivityDtl */ COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(L.LAST_LOGN_DATE, U.JOIN_DATE) < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND COALESCE(L.LAST_LOGN_DATE, U.JOIN_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INACTIVE30_CNTT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(L.LAST_LOGN_DATE, U.JOIN_DATE) < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INACTIVE90_CNTT FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT H.USER_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , MAX(H.LOGN_DATE) AS LAST_LOGN_DATE FROM TB_LOGHIS H WHERE H.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY H.USER_NUMB ) L ON L.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_STAT = #{active}

WITH COHORT AS ( SELECT U.USER_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , DATE(U.JOIN_DATE) AS JOIN_DATE FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.JOIN_DATE >= DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND U.JOIN_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) , RETURN_FLAG AS ( SELECT C.USER_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , MAX(CASE WHEN H.LOGN_DATE < DATE_ADD(C.JOIN_DATE, INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY1_RETURN , MAX(CASE WHEN H.LOGN_DATE < DATE_ADD(C.JOIN_DATE, INTERVAL 8 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY7_RETURN , MAX(CASE WHEN H.LOGN_DATE < DATE_ADD(C.JOIN_DATE, INTERVAL 31 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY30_RETURN FROM COHORT C LEFT JOIN TB_LOGHIS H ON H.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB AND H.LOGN_DATE >= DATE_ADD(C.JOIN_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND H.LOGN_DATE < DATE_ADD(C.JOIN_DATE, INTERVAL 31 DAY) GROUP BY C.USER_NUMB ) , RETENTION_SUMMARY AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY1_COHORT_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND F.DAY1_RETURN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY1_RETAINED_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY7_COHORT_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND F.DAY7_RETURN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY7_RETAINED_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY30_COHORT_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN C.JOIN_DATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND F.DAY30_RETURN = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DAY30_RETAINED_CNTT FROM COHORT C LEFT JOIN RETURN_FLAG F ON F.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB ) SELECT /* getUserRetentionList */ 1 AS PERIOD_DAYS , COALESCE(R.DAY1_COHORT_CNTT, 0) AS COHORT_CNTT , COALESCE(R.DAY1_RETAINED_CNTT, 0) AS RETAINED_CNTT , ROUND(COALESCE(R.DAY1_RETAINED_CNTT * 100.0 / NULLIF(R.DAY1_COHORT_CNTT, 0), 0), 1) AS RETENTION_RATE FROM RETENTION_SUMMARY R UNION ALL SELECT 7 AS PERIOD_DAYS , COALESCE(R.DAY7_COHORT_CNTT, 0) AS COHORT_CNTT , COALESCE(R.DAY7_RETAINED_CNTT, 0) AS RETAINED_CNTT , ROUND(COALESCE(R.DAY7_RETAINED_CNTT * 100.0 / NULLIF(R.DAY7_COHORT_CNTT, 0), 0), 1) AS RETENTION_RATE FROM RETENTION_SUMMARY R UNION ALL SELECT 30 AS PERIOD_DAYS , COALESCE(R.DAY30_COHORT_CNTT, 0) AS COHORT_CNTT , COALESCE(R.DAY30_RETAINED_CNTT, 0) AS RETAINED_CNTT , ROUND(COALESCE(R.DAY30_RETAINED_CNTT * 100.0 / NULLIF(R.DAY30_COHORT_CNTT, 0), 0), 1) AS RETENTION_RATE FROM RETENTION_SUMMARY R ORDER BY PERIOD_DAYS

WITH RECURSIVE DATE_RANGE AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AS STAT_DATE UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(D.STAT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS STAT_DATE FROM DATE_RANGE D WHERE D.STAT_DATE < #{endDate} ) , WITHDRAWAL_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(W.REQU_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , SUM(CASE WHEN W.WTHD_TYPE = #{soft} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WITHDRAWN_CNTT , SUM(CASE WHEN W.WTHD_TYPE = #{hard} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DELETE_CNTT FROM TH_USWTHD W WHERE W.REQU_DATE >= #{startDate} AND W.REQU_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(W.REQU_DATE) ) , RESTORE_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(W.RCOV_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS RESTORED_CNTT FROM TH_USWTHD W WHERE W.RCOV_DATE >= #{startDate} AND W.RCOV_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(W.RCOV_DATE) ) , SUSPEND_ACTIVITY AS ( SELECT DATE(S.STRT_DATE) AS STAT_DATE , COUNT(1) AS SUSPENDED_CNTT FROM TH_USSPND S WHERE S.STRT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND S.STRT_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(S.STRT_DATE) ) SELECT /* getUserChurnTrendList */ D.STAT_DATE AS STAT_DATE , COALESCE(W.WITHDRAWN_CNTT, 0) AS WITHDRAWN_CNTT , COALESCE(W.DELETE_CNTT, 0) AS DELETE_CNTT , COALESCE(S.SUSPENDED_CNTT, 0) AS SUSPENDED_CNTT , COALESCE(R.RESTORED_CNTT, 0) AS RESTORED_CNTT FROM DATE_RANGE D LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL_ACTIVITY W ON W.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN SUSPEND_ACTIVITY S ON S.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE LEFT JOIN RESTORE_ACTIVITY R ON R.STAT_DATE = D.STAT_DATE ORDER BY D.STAT_DATE
